description.value: Kumare is a Filipino restaurant, bakery, and catering operation in Richmond serving a full menu of classic dishes—adobo, sinigang, silog breakfasts, and housemade lumpia—alongside authentic baked goods that can be shipped across BC. The name itself comes from the Filipino term for a close female friend, and the restaurant leans into that communal spirit, drawing families and friend groups. A street food truck extends the menu to events and pop-up locations across the Lower Mainland.
